subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
15. A Limited company has certain borrowings from a consortium of banks.
classified into Funded loan and Non-funded facilities. The description of the
facilities is as under -
i.
Letters of credit
ii.  Cash credits
iii.  Bank guarantees
iv.  Overdrafts
v.  Standby Letter of credit (SBLC)

10
vi.  Bills discounted and purchased
vii.  Participation on Risk sharing basis
Choose the correct option with regard to Funded loans.
(A)  i, ii, vi, vii
(B)  ii, iv, vi, vii
(C)  ii, iii, iv, vi
(D)  i, v, vi, vii
(2 Marks)

Answer Key
MCQ No.
Correct Option
